FIRST RUN
Getting started
Use Embeder like a small embedded IDE: edit real files, build a real ELF, then inspect the evidence.

        

          
01
Edit the workspace
Open files from Explorer. Changes stay in memory until you save. Ctrl+S saves the active file.

          
02
Build the saved sources
Build snapshots C, startup, headers, assembly, and the linker script. GCC errors appear in Problems and open the exact file.

          
03
Run the verification loop
Build & Simulate boots the resulting ELF in Renode and checks the USART2 banner. The verdict is based on tool output.

          
04
Inspect the evidence
Use Simulation for UART output and the modeled boundary. Use Datasheet for SVD-backed registers. Use Extensions for MCP health.
